corrections.to: basis vectors with overlap eigenvalue below 1e-7 removed (near linear dependence; Appendix A.1)
corrections.reported_as: For the largest basis sets cc-pVTZ, cc-pVQZ, and cc-pV5Z at geometries R < 1.6 aB and cc-pVDZ at R < 1.4 aB, the Gaussian basis is nearly linearly dependent. We remove linearly dependent vectors with an overlap threshold of 10^-7. Although a smaller threshold could be used in the Hartree-Fock calculation, changing the energy by ~10^-6 EHa per atom, we find the resulting CCSD calculations with smaller thresholds to be numerically unstable.
